mapper.select: /* isry.itgcm.bizcmmns.cmmns.mapper.CaseMtgMapper.selectGrCaseMtgDtlList(집단 사례회의상세) */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T1.CASE_MTG_NO ORDER BY T1.CASE_MTG_NO) AS RNUM , T1.CASE_MTG_NO AS CASE_MTG_NO /* 사례회의번호(MT)*/ , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호(CS)*/ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수*/ , T1.MTG_PRNMNT_YMD AS MTG_PRNMNT_YMD /* 회의예정일자*/ , T1.PRNMNT_BGNG_HR AS PRNMNT_BGNG_HR /* 예정시작시간*/ , T1.PRNMNT_END_HR AS PRNMNT_END_HR /* 예정종료시간*/ , T1.MTG_HDMT_YMD AS MTG_HDMT_YMD /* 회의개최일자*/ , T1.HDMT_BGNG_HR AS HDMT_BGNG_HR /* 개최시작시간*/ , T1.HDMT_END_HR AS HDMT_END_HR /* 개최종료시간*/ , T1.PLACE_NM AS PLACE_NM /* 장소명*/ , T1.ATDRN_NMST_CN AS ATDRN_NMST_CN /* 참석자명단내용*/ , T1.MTG_ITOAGD_CN AS MTG_ITOAGD_CN /* 회의안건내용*/ , T1.MTG_CN AS MTG_CN /* 회의내용*/ , T1.MTG_RESULT_CN AS MTG_RESULT_CN /* 회의결과내용*/ , T1.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호*/ , T1.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부*/ , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디*/ , T1.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시*/ , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디*/ , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시*/ , T3.PIC_NO AS PIC_NO , (SELECT FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = T3.PIC_NO ) AS PIC_NM_ENCPT , T3.PIC_INST_NO AS PIC_INST_NO FROM SEB140 T1 /* 사례회의*/ , SEB100 T2 /* 사례기본*/ , SEB170 T3 /* 사례회의담당자*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MTG_NO = T3.CASE_MTG_NO AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부*/ AND T1.CASE_MTG_NO = #{CASE_MTG_NO} /* 사례회의 번호*/ ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RNUM = 1

/* selectCaseGrMtgAtdrnlList YOO.CHI.HOON */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T1.ATDRN_NO ORDER BY T1.ATDRN_NO) AS RNUM , T1.CASE_MTG_NO AS CASE_MTG_NO /* 사례회의번호(MT)*/ , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호(CS)*/ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수*/ , T1.ATDRN_NO AS ATDRN_NO /* 참석자번호*/ , ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(X.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 X WHERE X.ENFSN_NO = T1.ATDRN_NO) AS ATDRN_NM /* 참석자명*/ , T1.ATND_BGNG_HR AS ATND_BGNG_HR /* 참석자시간*/ , T1.ATND_END_HR AS ATND_END_HR /* 참석종료시간*/ , T1.RM_CN AS RM_CN /* 비고내용*/ , T1.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부*/ , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디*/ , T1.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시*/ , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디*/ , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시*/ FROM SEB160 T1 /* 사례회의참석자*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부*/ AND T1.CASE_MTG_NO = #{CASE_MTG_NO} /* 사례회의번호(MT)*/ ORDER BY T1.CASE_MTG_NO, T1.CASE_MNG_NO, T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, T1.FRST_REG_DT, T1.ATDRN_NO ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RNUM = 1

/* selectGrCaseMtgPiclList YOO.CHI.HOON */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T1.PIC_NO ORDER BY T1.PIC_NO) AS RNUM , T1.CASE_MTG_NO AS CASE_MTG_NO /* 사례회의번호(MT)*/ , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호(CS)*/ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수*/ , T1.PIC_NO AS PIC_NO /* 담당자번호*/ , ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(X.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 X WHERE X.ENFSN_NO = T1.PIC_NO) AS PIC_NM /* 담당자명*/ , T1.PIC_INST_NO AS PIC_INST_NO /* 담당지기관번호*/ , ( SELECT X.INST_NM FROM SAA000 X WHERE X.INST_NO = T1.PIC_INST_NO) AS PIC_INST_NM /* 담당자기관명*/ , T1.PRCDNG_WRT_YN AS PRCDNG_WRT_YN /* 회의록작성여부*/ , T1.RM_CN AS RM_CN /* 비고내용*/ , T1.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부*/ , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디*/ , T1.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시*/ , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디*/ , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시*/ FROM SEB170 T1 /* 사례회의담당자*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부*/ AND T1.CASE_MTG_NO = #{CASE_MTG_NO} /* 사례회의번호(MT)*/ ORDER BY T1.CASE_MTG_NO, T1.CASE_MNG_NO, T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, T1.FRST_REG_DT, T1.PIC_NO ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RNUM = 1

/* selectGrCaseMtgTrprList YOO.CHI.HOON */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T1.CASE_MTG_NO ORDER BY T1.CASE_MTG_NO) AS RNUM , T1.CASE_MTG_NO AS CASE_MTG_NO /* 사례회의번호(MT)*/ , T1.DEL_YN , C##RG.DEC_B64(T2.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM , T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD , T2.SXDC_SE_CD , T3.CASE_PIC_NO AS CASE_PIC_NO -- 사례담당자번호 , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = T3.CASE_PIC_NO) AS CASE_PIC_NM -- 사례담당자명 , T3.PIC_INST_NO AS PIC_INST_NO -- 담당자기관번호 , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = T3.PIC_INST_NO) AS PIC_INST_NM -- 담당자기관명 , T4.CASE_MNG_NO , T4.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , CONCAT(T4.CASE_MNG_NO , T4.CASE_MNG_ODRNO) AS CASE_MNG_NO_ODRNO , T4.TRPR_INFO_NO , T4.CASE_BGNG_YMD , T4.CASE_TRMN_YMD , T4.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD , T4.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , T4.GOAL_PLAN_CN , T4.YNGBGS_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD , T4.YNGBGS_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD , T4.YNGBGS_SE_NO , T4.RESDN_SHAPE_SE_CD , T4.FAM_CHAR_SE_CD , T4.RESIDE_SHAPE_SE_CD , T4.RESIDE_SHAPE_ETC_CN , T4.HEALTH_PROBM_CN , T4.TAKNG_DRFSTF_CN , T4.AFTFCT_MNG_YN , T4.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD , T4.ALTMNT_GROUP_SCLAS_SE_CD , T4.TAG_NM , T4.TAG_NO , T4.TRPR_PHOTO_ATFINO , T4.CASE_BGNG_HR , T4.CASE_TRMN_HR , #{CASE_MTG_NO} AS CASE_MTG_NO FROM SEB140 T1 /* 사례회의*/ , SEA200 T2 /* 대상자정보 */ , SEB150 T3 /* 사례담당자 */ , SEB100 T4 /* 사례기본*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T4.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T4.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T4.CASE_MNG_NO = T3.CASE_MNG_NO AND T4.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T2.TRPR_INFO_NO = T4.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부*/ AND T3.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' AND T1.CASE_MTG_NO = #{CASE_MTG_NO}
